fields.description: Show e-invoicing / eTransactions fields and actions on Customers, Suppliers and invoices. Off by default; the e-invoicing pipeline for a given customer is still driven by its eTransaction Profile.
fields.label: Enable E-Invoicing

fields.description: Receive invoices from accredited platforms that are configured and active. A site_config.json key, etransactions_disable_receiving, overrides this off regardless of this setting.
fields.label: Receive invoices from accredited platforms

fields.description: Send invoices to accredited platforms that are configured and active. A site_config.json key, etransactions_disable_sending, overrides this off regardless of this setting.
fields.label: Send invoices to accredited platforms

fields.description: By default, invoices are sent in Factur-X to French B2B customers, routed through the French directory. Enable the options below only if you need them.
fields.label: E-invoicing options

fields.description: Reach customers on the Peppol network and send UBL invoices. Off: invoices are always sent in Factur-X through the French directory.
fields.label: Peppol / UBL network

fields.description: Show the service code and contract reference required by public-sector customers (B2G / Chorus Pro).
fields.label: Public sector (B2G / Chorus Pro)

fields.description: Choose the Factur-X profile per customer and invoice. Off: the default profile (EN16931) is applied automatically.
fields.label: Choose Factur-X profile per customer

fields.description: Show the routing line on orders and invoices, directory pinning and accredited platform overrides per customer or customer group.
fields.label: Advanced routing & platform overrides
Generate FacturX PDF automatically when a Sales Invoice is submitted
Block submission if FacturX PDF generation fails

fields.description: Refuse submitting a Sales Invoice while blocking e-invoicing findings remain (the readiness panel lists them). Off = findings are shown but submission is allowed.
fields.label: Block submission on blocking e-invoicing findings

fields.description: Applied automatically to customers with a SIREN and a French (or empty) primary address that have no profile yet. The profile is the master switch of the e-invoicing pipeline.
fields.label: Default eTransaction Profile for French B2B customers

fields.description: Business process code (BT-23) carried by French CTC invoices. Must be one of B1, S1, M1, B2, S2, M2, B4, S4, M4, S5, S6, B7, S7 (BR-FR-08).
fields.label: Default Business Process Code (BT-23)
Create purchase invoices without purchase orders or purchase receipts

fields.description: Suggest item lines on a captured supplier invoice, from the supplier item mapping and, failing that, from that supplier's last invoice. Suggestions are always editable.
fields.label: Prefill item lines from supplier history
Block the creation of purchase invoices with a grand total exceeding the supplier invoice
Block the creation of purchase invoices with a net total exceeding the supplier invoice
Auto reconcile supplier invoices with purchase receipts
Max difference amount on net total
Max difference percentage on net total
Auto submit purchase invoices after creation

fields.description: Send 'In Hand' (prise en charge) when a supplier invoice is created from an incoming e-invoice.
fields.label: Auto-send 'In Hand' on supplier invoice creation

fields.description: Send 'Approved' (approuvée) when a purchase invoice linked to an incoming e-invoice is submitted.
fields.label: Auto-send 'Approved' on purchase invoice submission

fields.description: Send payment statuses ('Payment Sent' / 'Payment Received') when a payment is submitted against a linked invoice.
fields.label: Auto-send payment statuses on payment submission

fields.description: When the customer refuses an e-invoice (incoming 'Refused' status), automatically cancel the linked Sales Invoice. Off by default — cancellation is irreversible.
fields.label: Auto-cancel Sales Invoice on refusal
